Task: General Text Translation

Write Python code that translates HTML or markup while preserving tags using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_html(text, target_language):
    client = translate.Client()

    # Extract tags from the text
    tags = {}
    text_without_tags = ''
    tag_pattern = r'<([^>]+)>([^<]+)</\1>'
    for match in re.finditer(tag_pattern, text):
        tag_name = match.group(1)
        tag_content = match.group(2)
        tags[tag_name] = tag_content
        text_without_tags += f'<{tag_name}></{tag_name}>'

    # Translate the text without tags
    result = client.translate(text_without_tags, target_language=target_language)
    translated_text = result['translatedText']

    # Reinsert the original tags with their content
    for tag_name, tag_content in tags.items():
        translated_content = client.translate(tag_content, target_language=target_language)['translatedText']
        translated_text = translated_text.replace(f'<{tag_name}></{tag_name}>', f'<{tag_name}>{translated_content}</{tag_name}>')

    return translated_text
